seo.title: About Moha | True Morocco Tours
seo.description: Meet Mohamed (Moha), an Amazigh guide born in the desert of Merzouga, offering authentic tours across Morocco.

hero.title: Meet Your Guide
hero.intro: My name is Mohamed, but everyone calls me Moha. I am an Amazigh guide, born in the desert of Merzouga, in the southeast of Morocco. I grew up among the dunes, in a unique environment where nature, traditions, and hospitality are part of everyday life.

s1.title: The Desert in My Blood
s1.body: The desert is not just where I was born — it is part of who I am. It taught me patience, respect, and the importance of sharing. These are strong values in Amazigh culture, and I am proud to pass them on to the people I meet.

s2.title: From Curiosity to Calling
s2.body: From a young age, I was in contact with travelers coming to discover this region. That is how my passion for guiding began. Over the years, I have developed a deep knowledge of the desert, as well as many other regions of Morocco.

s3.title: All of Morocco, at Your Feet
s3.body: Today, I organize and guide tours across the country — from the dunes of Merzouga to imperial cities like Marrakech and Fes, as well as the Atlas Mountains, Chefchaouen (my favorite city), oases, and traditional villages.

quote.text: I care a lot about human connection. For me, every trip is more than a journey — it is a meeting, a shared experience, and a real cultural exchange.
quote.highlight: With me, you don't just visit Morocco. You experience it.

closing: Welcome, and I hope to meet you soon.
